article_publication_dates.name: article_publication_dates
article_publication_dates.value: "editorial"."articles"."published_revision_id" IS NULL OR ("editorial"."articles"."status" = 'published' AND "editorial"."articles"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "editorial"."articles"."modified_at" >= "editorial"."articles"."published_at")

asset_dimensions.name: asset_dimensions
asset_dimensions.value: ("editorial"."assets"."width" IS NULL AND "editorial"."assets"."height" IS NULL) OR ("editorial"."assets"."width" > 0 AND "editorial"."assets"."height" > 0)

redirect_valid.name: redirect_valid
redirect_valid.value: ("editorial"."redirects"."status" = 301 AND "editorial"."redirects"."to_path" IS NOT NULL AND "editorial"."redirects"."to_path" <> "editorial"."redirects"."from_path") OR ("editorial"."redirects"."status" = 410 AND "editorial"."redirects"."to_path" IS NULL)

review_valid.name: review_valid
review_valid.value: ("editorial"."review_details"."rating" IS NULL OR "editorial"."review_details"."rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND length(trim("editorial"."review_details"."method")) >= 30
